# Code snippet to validate file content type and sanitize filenames
import os

def is_image_file(file_path):
    valid_extensions = ['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.bmp', '.tiff']
    return os.path.splitext(file_path)[1].lower() in valid_extensions

def sanitize_filename(filename):
    return os.path.basename(filename)

# Example usage
file_path = "uploads/example.jpg"
assert is_image_file(file_path) == True
assert sanitize_filename("../uploads/example.jpg") == "example.jpg"
